tables.name: DropdownProps
rows: The trigger element that opens/closes the dropdown.
Optional header content that stays fixed at the top while scrolling dropdown content.
Optional footer content that stays fixed at the bottom while scrolling dropdown content. Typically used to display loading status or action buttons.
Called when the user clicks outside the dropdown. The dropdown does not close automatically - the `open` prop needs to be updated to actually close the dropdown.
Minimum width for the dropdown in pixels. If no value is specified, the dropdown will shrink to fit its content.
Maximum width for the dropdown in pixels. If no value is specified, the dropdown will expand to fit its content.
Called when the user presses the Escape key while the dropdown is open. The dropdown does not close automatically - the `open` prop needs to be updated to actually close the dropdown.
Called when any element inside the dropdown content gains focus. This includes nested interactive elements like buttons, links, or inputs.
Called when focus leaves the dropdown content entirely.
Adds `role` to the dropdown content element.
Adds `aria-label` to the dropdown content element.
Adds `aria-labelledby` to the dropdown content element.
Adds `aria-describedby` to the dropdown content element.
An object containing CSS properties to customize the dropdown's visual appearance. @awsuiSystem core
